sources.name: Department of Registrar of Companies and Intellectual Property (DRCIP)
sources.verdict: Verified. Official registry portal: eSearch of business entities, eFiling, certified copies, registration statistics. No bulk/API on this site itself — bulk route is data.gov.cy (see separate entries).

sources.name: DRCOR public company eSearch
sources.verdict: Verified. Public search of all registered organisations by name/number, no login required, phonetic and partial-word matching. Classic ASP.NET app — scrapeable per-entity lookups.

sources.name: data.gov.cy — Register of Companies, Business Names & Partnerships (full register)
sources.verdict: Verified — the flagship CY source. Three CSVs covering the whole register (5 entity types): organisations catalog (name, number, type, status, registration date), registered-office addresses, and officials/directors. Monthly refresh, CC-BY 4.0. Deterministic $0 ingest of the entire Cyprus corporate universe.

sources.name: data.gov.cy — Company registrations (new incorporations)
sources.verdict: Verified in portal search results; CSV from DRCIP. New-incorporation flow useful as a signal stream.

sources.name: data.gov.cy — Overseas (foreign) company registrations
sources.verdict: Verified in portal search results; CSV. Foreign companies registered in Cyprus (branch/overseas registrations).

sources.name: data.gov.cy national open data portal
sources.verdict: Verified. 1,900+ datasets from 95 public bodies; search path /el/search?f[0]=content_type:dataset.dataset. Hub for DRCIP, DLS and statistical datasets. Old CKAN API paths are dead (404) — new platform, HTML search.

sources.name: CySEC — regulated entities hub
sources.verdict: Verified. 11 entity categories: Investment Firms, AIFMs, AIF, UCITS & ManCos, ASPs, Issuers, Crowdfunding SPs, MiCAR crypto entities, Regulated Markets, MTFs, PEPPs. Each category has its own register page.

sources.name: CySEC — Cyprus Investment Firms (CIF) list
sources.verdict: Verified including the Excel: page states 'CIF regulated entities list as of 04 May 2026' with 'Click here to download in Excel format'. Hundreds of firms with licence number/date, registration number, contacts, trade names, status notes.

sources.name: CySEC — AIFM register
sources.verdict: Verified category page. Same register template as CIFs — probe each subpage for the Excel export (only the CIF Excel was directly confirmed this session).

sources.name: CySEC — AIF / RAIF / AIFLNP / EuVECA registers
sources.verdict: Verified. Four sub-registers (AIF, RAIF, AIFLNP, EuVECA & EuSEF) each behind its own page. The RAIF register is the key growth segment for CY alternatives.

sources.name: CySEC — UCITS & Management Companies register
sources.verdict: Verified category exists on the entities hub; per-page register in the standard CySEC list format.

sources.name: CySEC — Administrative Service Providers (ASP) register
sources.verdict: Verified category. ASPs (fiduciary/corporate administrators) are the core of the Cyprus institutional service graph — regulated by CySEC, full licensee list.

sources.name: CySEC — MiCAR CASP register (+ former CASPs)
sources.verdict: Verified URL structure from the MiCAR hub: active CASPs and Former-MiCAR-CASPs registers, plus a regulatory sandbox page. Covers MiCA-era crypto licensees (successor of the CBA register).

sources.name: CySEC — Crowdfunding Service Providers register
sources.verdict: Verified category on the entities hub (ECSP Regulation licensees).

sources.name: Central Bank of Cyprus — licensing & supervision registers
sources.verdict: Exists but returns HTTP 403 to automated fetchers (bot protection). Holds registers of credit institutions, payment/e-money institutions, and — critical for NPL coverage — credit-acquiring companies under the Sale of Credit Facilities Law. Needs a headless/browser fetch or manual pulls.

sources.name: EBA EUCLID registers (CY credit + payment institutions)
sources.verdict: Standing EU-level machine-readable route around the blocked CBC site: EBA's credit-institution and payment-institution registers cover all CY licensees with JSON/CSV access. Not fetch-verified this session (known infrastructure).

sources.name: ESMA Registers portal (CY AIFMs, ManCos, firms, MiCA passports)
sources.verdict: Verified portal loads (JS register app with downloadable datasets). EU-level cross-check and bulk route for CySEC-licensed AIFMs/UCITS ManCos/investment firms and MiCA entities.

sources.name: Insurance Companies Control Service (Superintendent of Insurance)
sources.verdict: Statutory keeper of the register of licensed insurance/reinsurance undertakings. Connection reset during verification; MoF sites are mid-migration to the (bot-blocked) gov.cy platform. Register exists; access route needs a browser session.

sources.name: Registrar of Occupational Retirement Benefit Funds (IORP register)
sources.verdict: The LP-side pension regulator (occupational retirement funds). Site has a broken TLS certificate — verification failed; register exists in law. Use EIOPA route below as the machine-accessible fallback.

sources.name: EIOPA Register of IORPs (covers Cyprus pension funds)
sources.verdict: EIOPA publishes the EU-wide IORP register (spreadsheet) including all Cyprus occupational pension funds — the practical bulk route given the national registrar's broken site. Not fetch-verified this session (known infrastructure).

sources.name: CERA — Cyprus Energy Regulatory Authority electricity licensees
sources.verdict: Verified via CERA homepage: Electricity Licensees List published, plus market-participant share data. Maps renewable-energy SPVs and IPPs for Real Assets & Infrastructure coverage.

sources.name: Department of Environment — EU ETS national administrator (Union Registry CY)
sources.verdict: Cyprus has no standalone carbon registry; ETS accounts sit in the EU Union Registry with the Department of Environment as national administrator. Gov sites bot-blocked; EUTL (EU Transaction Log) is the public data route for CY installations.

sources.name: Cyprus Official Gazette (Government Printing Office)
sources.verdict: The Επίσημη Εφημερίδα is published digitally by the GPO, but the site presented an invalid TLS certificate on verification (both https and http). Real and official; needs cert-tolerant fetching or manual pulls. Statutory notices (liquidations, receiverships) publish here.

sources.name: Department of Insolvency — registers hub
sources.verdict: Verified. Seven registers: court-ordered and voluntary liquidations, companies under receivership/administration, companies under examination, personal bankruptcies, debt-relief decrees, personal repayment plans. Formats per-register (probe each).

sources.name: Department of Insolvency — insolvency practitioners directory
sources.verdict: Verified. Register of licensed insolvency advisors (Σύμβουλοι Αφερεγγυότητας) — direct roll for the Private Debt & Credit service graph.

sources.name: CyLaw — Cyprus legal database (Bar Association)
sources.verdict: Verified. Free full-text court judgments (Supreme Court and lower courts, 1893–present) and consolidated legislation. The route to liquidation/receivership/insolvency case law.

sources.name: Cyprus Stock Exchange — regulated market issuers
sources.verdict: Verified via CSE homepage navigation. Full listing of regulated-market issuers in HTML tables.

sources.name: Cyprus Stock Exchange — Emerging Companies Market (ECM) issuers
sources.verdict: Verified path. The ECM hosts many funds and smaller issuers (including some AIF listings) — distinct list from the regulated market.

sources.name: Cyprus Stock Exchange — members (brokerage firms)
sources.verdict: Verified path (regulated + non-regulated member lists). Execution-broker layer of the service graph.

sources.name: CSE OAM — officially appointed mechanism (issuer filings)
sources.verdict: Exists ('XAK Public Pages') but is a JS single-page app — content not server-rendered. The storage point for regulated issuer disclosures; needs headless rendering or its underlying JSON endpoints mapped.

sources.name: CIFA — Cyprus Investment Funds Association member directory
sources.verdict: Verified with member names: fund managers (ECM Fund Management, Eleon Capital...), Big-4 audit, law firms (Tornaritis...), administrators (IQ-EQ, Trident Trust, Vistra). Each entry links to the member site — a pre-mapped service-graph seed.

sources.name: Cyprus Bar Association — advocates & law-firm registries
sources.verdict: Verified three searchable registries: advocates (CypriotAdvocateMembersPage.aspx), registered European lawyers, and lawyers' companies/partnerships (DepePage.aspx).

sources.name: ICPAC — Institute of Certified Public Accountants of Cyprus
sources.verdict: Returns 403 to automated fetchers. ICPAC licenses statutory auditors, many ASPs and insolvency practitioners; has a find-a-member search behind the bot wall.

sources.name: ETEK — Scientific & Technical Chamber member registers (incl. land valuers)
sources.verdict: Verified register URLs (member registers + firm catalogue at e-etek.org.cy/member_catalogue). ETEK's disciplines include Εκτίμηση Γης (land/property valuation) — the statutory valuer roll for real-asset work; RICS members overlap.

sources.name: Association of Cyprus Banks (ACB)
sources.verdict: Verified. 8 member banks, sector statistics (EUR 26.9bn loans / 56.9bn deposits), annual publications and 'Banking Insight'.

sources.name: Insurance Association of Cyprus (IAC)
sources.verdict: Verified. Member companies page plus a /en/statistics section and annual reports — the LP-side insurance market map.

sources.name: Cyprus Fiduciary Association (CYFA)
sources.verdict: Verified. Representative body of regulated ASPs since 2011 with an 'Our Members' directory — fund-administration/corporate-services layer.

sources.name: Invest Cyprus (CIPA — investment promotion agency)
sources.verdict: Returns 403 to automated fetchers. The national IPA; publishes sector pages (funds, fintech) and FDI news. Real, needs browser fetch.

sources.name: KEDIPES — Cyprus Asset Management Company (state NPL workout entity)
sources.verdict: Verified. Publishes quarterly progress reports (cash inflows, restructurings, recoveries) and announcements — the single best public window into the Cyprus NPL market.

sources.name: TechIsland — tech industry association
sources.verdict: Verified. Largest CY tech association (est. 2021); member showcase (Wargaming, Exness, JetBrains, Bolt), news and reports — VC-adjacent ecosystem map.

sources.name: CYBAN — Cyprus Business Angels Network
sources.verdict: Verified. The only angel network in Cyprus (EBAN member); 12 named portfolio companies, member stats, news/events.

sources.name: Research and Innovation Foundation (RIF/IdEK)
sources.verdict: Verified. National R&I funding authority; IRIS portal for calls (incl. Pre-Seed EUR 1m), active announcements. Grant awards signal early-stage dealflow.

sources.name: eProcurement Cyprus (e-PPS)
sources.verdict: Verified. Official public-procurement platform; tenders browsable without login (Recent Tenders, consultations, annual plans). No RSS found; TED is the EU-level structured mirror for above-threshold CY notices.

sources.name: Department of Lands and Surveys (DLS) portal
sources.verdict: Verified. Sales price statistics, general valuation data, interactive geoportal, INSPIRE downloads, state-property auction notices, private cadastral surveyor listings — core real-assets data layer.

sources.name: Cyprus Chamber of Commerce and Industry (CCCI/KEBE)
sources.verdict: Returns 403 to automated fetchers. Real; business directory and sector committees behind the bot wall.

sources.name: CFA Society Cyprus
sources.verdict: Existence verified via 301 redirect from cfacyprus.com; content not fetched this session. Small but genuine professional layer.

sources.name: CYSTAT — Statistical Service of Cyprus
sources.verdict: Redirect loop hit during automated verification (gov-platform bot behavior). Real national statistics office; macro/sector series also mirrored on data.gov.cy and Eurostat.

sources.name: Deputy Ministry of Shipping — Cyprus ship registry
sources.verdict: Not fetch-verified this session (gov.cy platform pattern). Cyprus runs a top-tier EU ship registry — relevant for maritime/real-asset structures; access route to be probed with a browser.

sources.name: Cyprus Mail
sources.verdict: Verified working RSS (25 items, current). English-language daily with business coverage — the most machine-friendly CY news source found.

sources.name: Politis
sources.verdict: Verified working WordPress RSS (current items). Greek-language daily with economy coverage.

sources.name: Sigmalive
sources.verdict: Verified working RSS 2.0 feed incl. Οικονομία (economy) items. Major broadcaster portal.

sources.name: Financial Mirror
sources.verdict: Site and standard WordPress /feed/ both return 403 to our fetcher (bot protection). Leading English-language CY financial title — real; needs UA/browser-based fetching. rssUrl is the conventional WP feed to retry.

sources.name: StockWatch
sources.verdict: 403 to automated fetchers. The reference CY markets/finance outlet (CSE data, banking, funds). Real; requires browser-grade fetching; RSS not confirmable this session.

sources.name: InBusiness News (IMH/Reporter)
sources.verdict: Verified. Full business verticals (finance, real estate, energy, ICT); server-rendered listing pages; no RSS found (/rss is 404) — parse section indexes.

sources.name: Cyprus Business News (CBN)
sources.verdict: Verified. English business coverage (companies, financial services, real estate). A /feed/ endpoint exists but returned an empty/null RSS channel — treat as broken; parse HTML.

sources.name: GoldNews / GOLD magazine (IMH)
sources.verdict: Verified. English business/finance coverage incl. professional services and real estate; no RSS found (/feed/ 404); parse section pages.

sources.name: Kathimerini Cyprus (Οικονομική)
sources.verdict: Fetch refused at network level this session. Real title with strong economy section; needs browser-grade access.

sources.name: Philenews (Ο Φιλελεύθερος)
sources.verdict: Fetch refused at network level this session. Largest Greek-language CY daily, economy section (Οικονομία); retry with browser fetching.

sources.name: Cyprus News Agency (CNA)
sources.verdict: 403 to automated fetchers. State news agency, economy wire; real, bot-walled.

sources.name: CySEC announcements & press
sources.verdict: Verified. Chronological announcements with year filter and page-size controls up to 150 — cleanly scrapeable; no RSS offered. Licensing decisions, sanctions, withdrawals = high-value signals.

sources.name: Central Bank of Cyprus press releases
sources.verdict: CBC site 403s automated fetchers throughout. Monetary/financial-stability and NPL statistics announcements; needs browser fetch.

sources.name: CSE announcements (regulated + ECM)
sources.verdict: Verified paths from CSE homepage (regulated-market and non-regulated-market announcement streams). Issuer corporate actions and fund listings; no RSS confirmed.

searchedButAbsent: Constraints first: the session's WebSearch budget was already exhausted (200/200) before this task started, so discovery ran on direct URL verification (~40 WebFetch probes, Greek and English paths) over the known Cyprus institutional set; anything listed js-blocked/unknown EXISTS but refused automated fetching. Searched and genuinely absent: (1) No dedicated national PE/VC association — Invest Europe has no Cyprus member association; CIFA (funds) and CYBAN (angels) fill the role. (2) No national development bank or promotional institution — the former Cyprus Development Bank was privatized long ago (cdbbank is commercial); early-stage public capital runs through the EIF-managed Cyprus Equity Fund and RIF grants. (3) No privatization agency — the Privatisation Unit was abolished in 2019; no portal exists. (4) No standalone national or voluntary carbon registry — only the EU Union Registry (Department of Environment as administrator; EUTL is the public data route). (5) No REIT register — Cyprus has no REIT regime. (6) No public UBO register access (post-2022 CJEU restriction, as expected). (7) No RSS anywhere on the official side — CySEC, CSE, CBC, eProcurement and CIFA offer none; on the press side only Cyprus Mail, Politis and Sigmalive have verified working feeds; CBN's feed exists but is empty; Financial Mirror/StockWatch feeds could not be confirmed through their bot walls. (8) No litigation-funding, royalty-fund or ILS-specific Cyprus registers or associations were found — those niches have no dedicated local infrastructure and are covered via CySEC AIF/RAIF registers. (9) Old CKAN API paths on data.gov.cy are dead — the new portal is HTML-search only, but the full company register remains downloadable as monthly CC-BY CSVs. (10) A Cyprus pension-funds association could not be verified this session and is omitted rather than guessed. Count honesty: 62 real sources catalogued; nothing padded.
